note: All people, companies, hosts, IPs and domains are fictional. IPs use reserved documentation ranges. 'test_expectation' is the answer key for testing your scorer and should be hidden from the model.

cases.title: Fake payroll update email with credential harvesting link
timeline: 08:41 - Gateway flagged email sent to 3 recipients
08:55 - Headers show SPF fail and lookalike domain registered 2 days ago
09:10 - URL detonated in sandbox; page mimics company SSO login
09:30 - Email purged from all 3 mailboxes
09:45 - Proxy logs show 1 user (t.nguyen) clicked the link, no form submission seen
10:05 - t.nguyen password reset and sessions revoked as precaution
cases.analyst_notes: Lookalike domain with SPF fail. Sandbox confirmed credential harvesting page. All 3 recipients identified from gateway logs and email purged. Proxy logs confirm only one click and no POST to the phishing site. Precautionary reset done. Blocked domain at proxy.

test_expectation.reason: Complete evidence, every checklist item supported

cases.title: Suspicious invoice email reported by user
timeline: 13:02 - User reported suspicious invoice email
13:20 - Analyst reviewed email
13:25 - Case closed
cases.analyst_notes: Looks like phishing. Deleted the email from the user's mailbox.

test_expectation.reason: No URL/attachment analysis, no recipient list, other recipients never checked

cases.title: Info-stealer detected on finance laptop
timeline: 06:12 - EDR flagged invoice_viewer.exe as info-stealer
06:20 - Host isolated via EDR
06:45 - Hash matched known info-stealer family on 3 reputation sources
07:30 - Process tree shows exe spawned from a downloaded zip in the browser cache
09:15 - Hunt across fleet: no other host with same hash or C2 domain contact
13:00 - Browser credentials for r.banerjee reset
15:40 - Host reimaged and returned to user
cases.analyst_notes: Confirmed info-stealer. Host isolated within 8 minutes. Fleet-wide hunt found no other infections. Credentials reset, host reimaged, C2 domain blocked.

test_expectation.reason: Complete evidence and all checklist items supported

cases.title: Hacking tool flagged on IT admin workstation
timeline: 10:05 - EDR flagged netprobe.exe as potentially unwanted hacking tool
10:40 - Hash found on reputation sources, flagged by some as 'dual-use tool'
11:15 - Process tree shows launched manually by admin user
12:10 - Case closed
cases.analyst_notes: Tool is dual-use and may be a legitimate admin tool used for network checks. User is in the IT team so this is probably authorised. However it was run at 02:00 local time and a change ticket could not be found. Marking as benign for now.

test_expectation.reason: Ambiguous: notes support both benign and suspicious, no change ticket, odd hour, no host isolation decision justified

cases.title: Impossible travel alert for sales user
timeline: 07:30 - Alert: logins from two countries 40 minutes apart
07:45 - Second IP belongs to a commercial VPN provider
08:10 - User contacted by phone, confirmed using personal VPN on mobile while laptop was on office network
08:20 - Same device ID on both logins, MFA prompt approved on registered phone
08:40 - Mailbox rules and recent sign-ins reviewed, nothing unusual
cases.analyst_notes: Both logins from the user's registered device. Second IP is VPN. User confirmed by phone. MFA satisfied on registered device. No new mailbox rules or permission changes. No compromise indicators. Advised user on VPN use policy.

test_expectation.reason: Evidence complete and supports the false positive verdict

cases.title: Many failed logins followed by success, then new mailbox rule
timeline: 09:02 - 14 failed logins from source IP
09:07 - Successful login from same IP
09:15 - Mailbox rule created forwarding mail to external address
09:50 - Case closed
cases.analyst_notes: Probably the user mistyping password and then logging in. Closing as false positive.

test_expectation.reason: User never contacted, mailbox forwarding rule ignored, verdict contradicts evidence

cases.title: External port scan against public web server
timeline: 22:15 - Firewall flagged sequential scan from external IP
22:30 - IP reputation: listed on 2 public abuse lists as scanner
22:45 - Firewall logs show all connection attempts to closed ports dropped, only 443 reached web server
23:20 - Web server logs reviewed, no unusual requests
00:15 - Source IP added to block list
cases.analyst_notes: Opportunistic scan. Only port 443 reachable, which is expected. No exploit attempts in web logs. No other internal assets contacted by this IP. Blocked at perimeter.

test_expectation.reason: All evidence present and scoped, block action recorded

cases.title: Large upload of confidential files to personal cloud storage
timeline: 15:10 - DLP flagged 212 files uploaded to personal cloud storage
15:30 - Files classified Confidential (project documents)
16:00 - Manager said user may have been sharing files with a vendor, not sure
16:45 - Case closed
cases.analyst_notes: Manager believes this could be a vendor handoff, but no approved vendor sharing request was found. User not yet contacted. Possibly benign business activity. Marking benign pending confirmation.

test_expectation.reason: File access logs missing, user intent unconfirmed, no access revoked, ambiguous verdict on confidential data

cases.title: DLP alert for card numbers in outbound email
timeline: 11:00 - DLP flagged 40 card-like numbers in outbound attachment
11:20 - Numbers match published payment-gateway test card ranges, all fail real-issuer checks
11:40 - QA lead confirmed attachment is a test dataset for a payment feature
11:55 - Data classification record confirms file is tagged Test Data - No Real Customer Data
12:10 - Vendor is an approved contractor with signed NDA on record
cases.analyst_notes: All numbers are known test card numbers. QA lead confirmed purpose. Vendor is approved. No real customer data involved. Data owner informed of the alert. No block needed.

test_expectation.reason: Classification, intent and notification all documented

cases.title: Storage bucket found publicly readable
timeline: 04:20 - Scanner flagged bucket with public read access
05:00 - Public access removed
06:30 - Attempted to pull access logs to check for external reads
07:00 - Case closed
cases.analyst_notes: Public access removed. Access logs for this bucket were not enabled so we cannot tell whether anyone external read the files. Assuming marketing files are not sensitive. Closed as resolved.

test_expectation.reason: Required logs unavailable, exposure window unknown, owner not notified, 'no impact' is unsupported

cases.title: Periodic outbound connections to unknown domain
timeline: 14:00 - Detection of regular 60-second beacons from one workstation
14:25 - Domain looked normal to analyst
14:40 - Case closed
cases.analyst_notes: Domain looks like a normal sync service. Closing as benign.

test_expectation.reason: No reputation check, no traffic analysis, asset not scoped, regular beaconing never explained

cases.title: Cloud access key exposed in public code repository
timeline: 09:00 - Secret scanner found cloud access key in a public commit
09:10 - Key revoked and rotated
09:40 - Commit history shows key exposed for 3 days
10:30 - Cloud audit logs for the full 3 days show no use of the key from outside company IP ranges
11:15 - Service account permissions reviewed, read-only on reporting data
12:00 - Repo history cleaned and secret scanning pre-commit hook enabled
13:30 - Service owner notified and acknowledged
cases.analyst_notes: Key revoked within 10 minutes of detection. Exposure window was 3 days. Full audit logs reviewed and show no external use. Permissions were read-only. Owner informed. Preventive control added.
cases.verdict: True Positive - Contained, No Misuse Found

test_expectation.reason: Exposure window, log review, fix and owner notification all documented
